description: Lists the connection modes and PG/PC interfaces TIA Portal sees for this PLC's CPU — name, number, target interfaces — plus each adapter's status in the serve host's OS (Up/Down/… or not_found_in_os: a DISABLED adapter is invisible). NO network scan (unlike tia_accessible_devices, GATE G7). Use it to pick connectionMode/pcInterfaceName/targetInterfaceName for tia_download. Requires app ≥ v1.6.0. Maps to GET /plcs/{plc}/pginterfaces. Read-only (class R).
name: tia_pg_interfaces
title: TIA — PG/PC interfaces (no scan)
